# PICO Developer Documentation: spatial

This document provides a comprehensive overview and learning roadmap for the PICO Developer documentation specific to the spatial platform.

## Document Directory

### spatial-sdk

[LLM resources for AI](./spatial-sdk_llm-resources-for-ai.md): This document describes asset types, loading, and resource management. Key topics include: llms.txt URLs, Usage recommendations.
[ToolTip](./spatial-sdk_content-layout-and-presentation_add-spatial-effects-to-2d-content_tooltip.md): This document provides release, limitation, issue, or reference information. ToolTip is a tooltip modifier provided by Spatial UI that displays additional text, including title and description, when the user hovers. It also supports configuring the display orientation.

When overlaying and displaying semi-transparent 3D content and 2D panels within WindowContainer, the display may be abnormal. When using both Modifier.spatialHoverEffect and Modifier.

[Tween animation](./spatial-sdk_animation_tween-animation.md): This document explains animation systems, timelines, and model animation effects. Its core principle is to drive dynamic deformation of the model by simulating a hierarchical skeletal structure composed of connected joints... Key topics include: Example project, glTF vs USD, How glTF handles animations, How USD handles animations.
[Learn about the ECS architecture](./spatial-sdk_ecs_learn-about-the-ecs-architecture.md): This document covers the ECS architecture and entity/component workflows. The entity-component-system (ECS) architecture is a data-oriented design (DOD) pattern that improves performance and scalability by separating data and logic. Key topics include: DOD vs OOD, Core elements, Use cases, ECS architecture design of PICO Spatial SDK.

[Additive Mix](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_additive-mix.md): This document explains rendering, materials, lighting, or visual effects. An operation that mixes by adding the foreground value to the background value. The calculation formula is: B + F. Parameter description Key topics include: Parameter description, Node usage instructions.
[Screen](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_screen.md): This document explains rendering, materials, lighting, or visual effects. A blending operation that brightens areas darker than white. This node first inverts the color values of the foreground and background separately, multiplies these results, and then inverts the final result again. Key topics include: Parameter description, Node usage instructions.
[Mask](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_mask.md): This document explains rendering, materials, lighting, or visual effects. Outputs the area in the background that overlaps with the foreground Alpha. The Mask node uses the Alpha channels of the foreground and background input to determine the output. Key topics include: Parameter description, Node usage instructions.
[In](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_in.md): This document explains rendering, materials, lighting, or visual effects. Outputs the regions of the foreground where the Alpha channel overlaps with the background. In node uses the Alpha channels of the foreground and background inputs to determine the output. Key topics include: Parameter description, Node usage instructions.
[Out](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_out.md): This document explains rendering, materials, lighting, or visual effects. Outputs the areas of the foreground that do not overlap with the background. The Out node uses the Alpha channels of the foreground and background input to determine the output result. Key topics include: Parameter description, Node usage instructions.
[Matte](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_mask_matte.md): This document explains rendering, materials, lighting, or visual effects. A merging operation that overlays a premultiplied Alpha foreground layer onto the background. The Matte node uses the Alpha channels of the foreground and background input to determine the output. Key topics include: Parameter description, Node usage instructions.
[Dodge](./spatial-toolkit_pico-spatial-editor_materials_shader-graph_composition_blend_dodge.md): This document explains rendering, materials, lighting, or visual effects. Dodge is a blending operation that brightens the background layer based on the foreground. The calculation formula is B/(1 - F). Parameter description Key topics include: Parameter description, Node usage instructions.

Multiply the complement of the mask by all channels of the Input. Outside node multiplies 1 − mask by all channels of the Input. Visually, this is equivalent to retaining the areas outside the mask. Parameter description Key topics include: Parameter description, Node usage instructions.

## Learning Roadmap

A practical learning path is to move from concepts to implementation, then from core capabilities to advanced topics:
1. **Foundational concepts**: Start with Understand PICO Spatial SDK and spatial apps, Overview, Understand spatial containers & space state to build the background needed for this stage.
2. **Quickstart**: Start with Step 2: Create your first spatial app to build the background needed for this stage.
3. **Spatial containers and state**: Start with About the default spatial container and default activity, Manage the lifecycle and state of a Stage, Manage the lifecycle and state of a WindowContainer to build the background needed for this stage.
4. **ECS architecture**: Start with Learn about the ECS architecture, Themes and components of Spatial UI, Length unit conversion to build the background needed for this stage.
5. **Spatial UI and content layout**: Start with Controller tracking, TextField, Button to build the background needed for this stage.
6. **Resource management**: Start with LLM resources for AI, Spatial mesh, Mesh to build the background needed for this stage.
7. **Animation and timelines**: Start with Animation system, Tween animation, Orbit animation to build the background needed for this stage.
8. **Rendering and visual effects**: Start with Image-based lighting, ShaderGraphMaterial, Dynamic shadowing to build the background needed for this stage.
9. **Interaction and tracking**: Start with Eye Tracking, Object Tracking, Interact with entities to build the background needed for this stage.
10. **Audio and video**: Start with Use SpatialAudioTrackExtension, Sample: Create an immersive audio experience, Use audio events to build the background needed for this stage.
11. **Physics simulation**: Start with Set parameters for the physics world, Physics simulation process, Sample: Add physics to your app to build the background needed for this stage.
12. **Mixed-reality perception**: Start with Plane detection, Spatial anchor to build the background needed for this stage.
13. **SpatialML**: Start with SpatialML privacy statement, SpatialML basic concepts, SpatialML best practices to build the background needed for this stage.
14. **Performance and debugging**: Start with Scene complexity, Performance optimization, Metrics HUD (Metrics HUD) to build the background needed for this stage.
15. **Release, issue, and reference material**: Start with ToolTip, Known issues, Release notes to build the background needed for this stage.
After completing the path, return to the document directory for the specific API, component, or sample required by your scenario.

## Practical Use Cases

- **Create a Spatial app from scratch**: Use these documents for the required concepts, implementation steps, and validation guidance -> Relevant Docs: Understand PICO Spatial SDK and spatial apps, Overview, Understand spatial containers & space state, SpatialML overview
- **Build 2D/3D spatial interfaces**: Use these documents for the required concepts, implementation steps, and validation guidance -> Relevant Docs: Controller tracking, TextField, Button, Switch
- **Author immersive 3D scenes**: Use these documents for the required concepts, implementation steps, and validation guidance -> Relevant Docs: LLM resources for AI, Spatial mesh, Mesh, Model
- **Implement natural interaction and tracking**: Use these documents for the required concepts, implementation steps, and validation guidance -> Relevant Docs: Eye Tracking, Object Tracking, Interact with entities, 3D hover highlight effect
- **Add audio, video, and media experiences**: Use these documents for the required concepts, implementation steps, and validation guidance -> Relevant Docs: Use SpatialAudioTrackExtension, Sample: Create an immersive audio experience, Use audio events, Use audio mixer group
- **Add physics, collisions, or raycasts**: Use these documents for the required concepts, implementation steps, and validation guidance -> Relevant Docs: Set parameters for the physics world, Physics simulation process, Sample: Add physics to your app, Raycast
- **Blend virtual content with the real environment**: Use these documents for the required concepts, implementation steps, and validation guidance -> Relevant Docs: Plane detection, Spatial anchor, About the default spatial container and default activity, Manage the lifecycle and state of a Stage
- **Debug performance and compatibility issues**: Use these documents for the required concepts, implementation steps, and validation guidance -> Relevant Docs: Scene complexity, Performance optimization, Metrics HUD (Metrics HUD), Retrieve and analyze trace records
